Find the right massage therapist, get more from your massage appointments, and learn what you can do between visits.

Massage Therapy Tips by Graceful Touch provides practical consumer education about deep tissue massage, choosing a massage therapist, massage pressure, communication, preparing for appointments, evaluating your results, and self-help between massage sessions.

Want more help? Join our free Massage Therapy community for additional tips, resources, discussions, and self-help education:

facebook.com/groups/deeptissue

Graceful Touch is based in Rapid City, South Dakota, while this channel provides massage education for viewers everywhere.

Subscribe for massage therapy tips, deep tissue education, and practical self-help between appointments.
